payload.name: AbhiBus
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The AbhiBus AI Assistant helps travellers make better bus travel decisions with clear visibility into available options. It is designed for discovery and comparison.

Users can search routes and instantly explore bus availability with filters such as departure window, bus type (AC/Non-AC/Sleeper/Seater), operator, and budget. The assistant presents structured results so travelers can quickly understand what is available and choose confidently.

What this app is for:
- Better decision-making before booking
- Clear visibility into bus availability on a route
- Fast comparison of options by time, type, and price
- Conversational filtering based on traveler preferences

AbhiBus AI Assistant simplifies travel planning by turning raw availability data into clear, actionable choices.
payload.longDescription:
AbhiBus AI Assistant帮助旅客清楚了解可用选项，从而作出更好的巴士出行决策。它专为查找和比较而设计。

用户可以搜索路线，并通过出发时间范围、巴士类型（有空调/无空调/卧铺/座席）、运营商和预算等筛选条件，即时查看巴士供应情况。助手以结构化形式呈现结果，让旅客快速了解可用选项并放心选择。

此应用的用途：
- 在预订前作出更好的决策
- 清楚了解某条路线的巴士供应情况
- 按时间、类型和价格快速比较选项
- 根据旅客偏好通过对话筛选

AbhiBus AI Assistant将原始供应数据转化为清晰、可执行的选择，简化旅行规划。

payload.name: redBus
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find buses between two cities on redBus and quickly narrow down options with filters for amenities (AC, sleeper, onboard washroom), price, departure time, and bus operator.

payload.name: Rome2Rio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Rome2Rio helps you figure out how to get anywhere in the world. 
Ask for any trip—from local routes to global journeys—and instantly see ways to get there by train, bus, ferry, car, flight, and even combinations of each, all in one place. The map makes it easy to view and compare your travel options.
You’ll get clear, door-to-door route options with travel times, connections, and estimated prices. When available, Rome2Rio also shows schedules and ticket details so you can plan with confidence.
Whether you’re comparing transport modes, mapping a complex itinerary, or making on-the-go decisions, Rome2Rio makes it easy to understand your options and choose the best way to get there.

payload.name: TUI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Discover your ideal holiday with the TUI ChatGPT app. Simply tell us what you're looking for, and we'll instantly match you with the best hotels and experiences. Search by location, ratings, dates, and duration to find holidays that suit you to a tee. No fuss. No endless scrolling. Just smarter holiday planning.

payload.name: IHG Hotels & Resorts
payload.description: 搜索全球 7000 多家酒店
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
With 7,000+ hotels across 100+ countries, IHG Hotels & Resorts delivers true hospitality for every kind of traveler. From memorable luxury stays to dependable comfort, IHG helps you find the right hotel, wherever your journey takes you.

Discover iconic brands like InterContinental, Kimpton, Crowne Plaza, Hotel Indigo, Holiday Inn, and more, each offering a distinctive stay experience, united by a shared commitment to true hospitality. Whether you’re planning a business trip, city getaway, or seaside escape, IHG makes it easy to find a stay that fits your travel needs.

Plan your next getaway by simply describing your ideal stay in the IHG app with ChatGPT.

Try searches like:
"Find a hotel tonight nearby for less than $200"
"Show me hotels for the perfect romantic getaway"
"Where's the best hotel near the Mercedes-Benz Stadium?"

Easily explore our global portfolio, compare options, and plan your stay with ease. When you’re ready to book, complete your reservation securely on IHG.com.

Also, with IHG One Rewards, every stay is more rewarding. Members unlock exclusive rates, earn redeem points at thousands of hotels worldwide, and enjoy flexible booking benefits.

Let’s get started on your stay!
payload.longDescription:
IHG Hotels & Resorts 在 100+ 个国家/地区拥有 7,000+ 家酒店，为各种旅行者提供真正的待客服务。从令人难忘的奢华住宿到可靠舒适的体验，IHG 帮助你在旅程所到之处找到合适的酒店。

探索 InterContinental、Kimpton、Crowne Plaza、Hotel Indigo、Holiday Inn 等标志性品牌；每个品牌都提供独特的住宿体验，同时秉持共同的真诚待客承诺。无论你计划商务旅行、城市短途游还是海滨度假，IHG 都能让你轻松找到符合旅行需求的住宿。

只需在 ChatGPT 的 IHG 应用中描述理想住宿，即可规划下一次出行。

可以尝试：
“查找今晚附近低于 $200 的酒店”
“显示适合完美浪漫度假的酒店”
“Mercedes-Benz Stadium 附近最好的酒店在哪里？”

轻松探索全球酒店组合、比较选项并规划住宿。准备预订时，在 IHG.com 上安全完成预订。

此外，IHG One Rewards 让每次住宿都更有价值。会员可享专属价格，在全球数千家酒店赚取和兑换积分，并享受灵活的预订权益。

现在就开始规划住宿吧！

payload.name: Hilton Hotel Search
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Hilton Hotel Search helps users find Hilton properties by location, compare stay pricing, and inspect hotel details before continuing to Hilton booking flows.
payload.longDescription: Hilton Hotel Search 帮助用户按地点查找 Hilton 酒店、比较住宿价格，并在继续前往 Hilton 预订流程之前查看酒店详情。

payload.name: Traveloka
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search for flights on Traveloka directly in ChatGPT. Tell it where and when you want to fly — round-trip or one-way, for one traveler or many — and get available routes, schedules, and prices, covering Southeast Asia and destinations worldwide. Sort and filter the results to quickly find the flight that fits you best.

payload.name: Reagent Travel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Reagent Travel turns flight search into a guided conversation, helping you quickly find the right option without digging through endless lists of results. 

Understand the key decision points for your trip by comparing trade-offs around price, schedule, stops, flexibility, comfort, and whatever else matters most - then discover better-fitting options as your priorities become clear. 

Compare choices in context, know why one flight fits better than another, and tap Book when you’ve found the right one.

payload.name: Priceline
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Planning a trip? Add Priceline to search for hotels right in your conversation. Tell ChatGPT where you're going, when, and what matters — close to downtown, near the beach, budget-friendly — and get results on an interactive map with live Priceline deals. Easily compare options, then book on Priceline or continue your conversation with Penny, Priceline's AI travel agent.

payload.name: EaseMyTrip
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: EaseMyTrip helps users search available flights and hotels from ChatGPT. Users can compare flight options by route, dates, cabin, stops, fare type, airline, and time windows; search hotel stays by destination, dates, guests, ratings, amenities, and price.
payload.longDescription: EaseMyTrip 可帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 搜索有空位的航班和酒店。用户可以按航线、日期、舱位、中转次数、票价类型、航空公司和时间范围比较航班选项；也可以按目的地、日期、住客人数、评分、设施和价格搜索住宿。

payload.name: Pegasus Airlines
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find affordable flights with Pegasus Airlines directly in ChatGPT. Search for budget friendly flight options, compare available routes, and check your flight status in seconds. Whether you are planning your next trip or tracking an upcoming journey, the Pegasus app helps you move faster from search to booking.

payload.name: Marriott Bonvoy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find the stay that fits your journey.

Explore Marriott Bonvoy’s portfolio of over 30 hotel brands and 10,000 global destinations. Whether you're planning a family vacation, business trip, or weekend getaway, discover hotels and resorts designed for every style of travel.

Click "Book Now" to book on the Marriott Bonvoy app or Marriott.com and enroll in Marriott Bonvoy to start enjoying member benefits.
payload.longDescription:
找到适合你旅程的住宿。
探索 Marriott

Bonvoy 旗下 30 多个酒店品牌和全球 10,000 多个目的地。无论你计划家庭度假、商务出差还是周末短途旅行，都能发现适合各种旅行方式的酒店和度假村。

点击“立即预订”即可在 Marriott
 Bonvoy 应用或 Marriott.com 上预订，并加入 Marriott Bonvoy 享受会员权益。

payload.name: Travel Advisory
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Stay informed. Travel smarter. Stay safe.

Travel Advisory helps you understand safety, health, and risk conditions for countries around the world using official U.S. State Department travel advisories and related global indicators.

Before you book or travel, you can quickly check:

Official Travel Advisories
View government travel advisory levels, key safety concerns, and official warnings for any destination.

Traveler-Specific Risk Insights
Understand how safety conditions may differ for solo travelers, families, business trips, and remote workers.

Political & Stability Context
Review governance, freedom, and security indicators to better understand local conditions.

Country Comparisons
Compare travel advisories and risk factors across multiple countries to help choose between destinations.

Whether you’re planning a vacation, a work trip, or a long-term stay, Travel Advisory makes it easier to make informed travel decisions using clear, official safety information.

Try asking questions like:
- “Is France safe to visit right now?”
- “Which is safer for travel, Mexico or Costa Rica?”
- “How risky is this destination for families?”
- “What are the main safety concerns in this country?”

Travel Advisory is not affiliated with or endorsed by the U.S. government.
Advisory information reflects the latest published updates from official sources and is refreshed daily.
© 2026 TravelAdvisory. Built with love for travelers and developers worldwide.
payload.longDescription:
及时了解信息。更聪明地旅行，确保安全。

Travel Advisory 使用美国国务院官方旅行警示和相关全球指标，帮助你了解世界各国的安全、健康和风险状况。

预订或出行前，你可以快速查询：

官方旅行警示
查看目的地的政府旅行警示级别、主要安全问题和官方警告。

针对旅行者的风险洞察
了解独自旅行者、家庭、商务旅行和远程工作者面临的安全状况可能有何不同。

政治与稳定状况
查看治理、自由和安全指标，以更好地了解当地情况。

国家/地区比较
比较多个国家/地区的旅行警示和风险因素，帮助选择目的地。

无论你是在规划度假、商务旅行还是长期停留，Travel Advisory 都能利用清晰、官方的安全信息，帮助你更轻松地做出明智旅行决策。

你可以尝试这样提问：
- “现在去法国安全吗？”
- “去墨西哥还是哥斯达黎加旅行更安全？”
- “这个目的地对家庭旅行有多大风险？”
- “这个国家/地区有哪些主要安全问题？”

Travel Advisory 与美国政府无关联，也未获其认可。
咨询信息反映官方来源最近发布的更新，并每日刷新。
© 2026 TravelAdvisory。为世界各地的旅行者和开发者倾情打造。

payload.name: Iberia
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Iberia GPT helps you plan your trip directly in ChatGPT. Search for Iberia flights, compare available options, explore destination ideas when you are not sure where to go, and use flexible dates to find the best deals for your plans. Once you choose your flight, you can continue the booking process securely through Iberia.
payload.longDescription: Iberia GPT 可直接在 ChatGPT 中帮助规划旅程。搜索 Iberia 航班、比较可选方案；如果还没确定目的地，也可以探索目的地灵感；还可以使用灵活日期，为行程寻找优惠。选好航班后，你可以通过 Iberia 安全地继续预订流程。

payload.name: ixigo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Plan smarter trips with flights, hotels, fare insights, and real-time travel updates - all within ChatGPT, powered by ixigo.

Search and compare one-way and round-trip flights across domestic and international routes with live fares, schedules, and flexible filtering. Discover hotels with your preferences - whether you're looking near a landmark, in a specific area, or with amenities like free breakfast,  jacuzzi, or couple-friendly stays.

Stay updated with live flight tracking and use fare intelligence to explore price trends across nearby dates, helping you find better deals. For last-mile travel, seamlessly continue to ixigo for cab bookings.

The experience adapts to your intent and prompts for missing details when needed, making travel planning faster, more intuitive, and personalized.
payload.longDescription:
借助 ixigo，在 ChatGPT 中规划更明智的行程，查询航班、酒店、票价信息和实时旅行动态。

搜索并比较国内及国际航线的单程和往返航班，查看实时票价和时刻表，并灵活筛选。根据偏好查找酒店，例如靠近地标、位于特定区域，或提供免费早餐、按摩浴缸、适合情侣入住等设施。

通过实时航班跟踪掌握最新动态，并利用票价分析了解临近日期的价格趋势，帮助你找到更优惠的选择。对于最后一程出行，可无缝前往 ixigo 预订出租车。

体验会根据你的意图进行调整，并在需要时询问缺失信息，让旅行规划更快捷、直观且个性化。

payload.name: FlixBus
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Plan a trip with FlixBus directly in ChatGPT. Search routes between supported destinations across the globe, browse available bus and train options for your chosen date and proceed directly to checkout.
payload.longDescription: 直接在 ChatGPT 中使用 FlixBus 规划行程。搜索全球支持目的地之间的路线，浏览所选日期可用的巴士和火车选项，然后直接前往结账。

payload.name: CheapOair
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The CheapOair app allows users to search and compare airline flight options based on their origin, destination, travel dates, passenger details and cabin preference, and to search and compare hotel stays based on destination, check-in and check-out dates, guest occupancy and stay filters. The app does not collect payment or complete bookings within ChatGPT. When a user selects “Book on CheapOair,” they are redirected to Cheapoair.com, where fare or rate validation, traveller information, payment, ticketing, cancellations and refunds are handled.
payload.longDescription: CheapOair 应用允许用户根据出发地、目的地、旅行日期、乘客信息和舱位偏好搜索并比较航班，也可根据目的地、入住和退房日期、入住人数及住宿筛选条件搜索并比较酒店。应用不会在 ChatGPT 内收集付款或完成预订。用户选择“在 CheapOair 上预订”后会被重定向到 Cheapoair.com，由该网站处理票价或房价验证、旅客信息、付款、出票、取消和退款。

payload.name: Cruise Critic
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search for cruise vacations filtered by destination, price, dates and preferred cruise line
payload.longDescription: 按目的地、价格、日期和偏好的邮轮公司筛选并搜索邮轮假期

payload.name: Hyatt
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Plan your next Hyatt stay directly in ChatGPT. Search Hyatt hotels and resorts around the world and access information available on Hyatt.com—including real-time room availability, detailed room descriptions, and dynamic rate information—through simple, natural conversation. 
 
Ask for what you need in everyday language, browse tailored results with photos and amenities, and click through to Hyatt.com when you're ready to book. Log in or join World of Hyatt during booking to earn points, access exclusive member rates, and enjoy added benefits. 
 
Add the Hyatt app in ChatGPT and make planning your next trip effortless.
payload.longDescription:
直接在 ChatGPT 中规划下一次凯悦住宿。搜索全球 Hyatt 酒店和度假村，并通过简单自然的对话查询 Hyatt.com 上的信息，包括实时客房空房情况、详细房型说明和动态价格信息。

用日常语言说出需求，浏览带照片和设施信息的定制结果，准备预订时点击前往 Hyatt.com。预订时登录或加入 World of Hyatt，即可赚取积分、享受会员专属价格和其他福利。

在 ChatGPT 中添加 Hyatt 应用，让下一次旅行规划轻松起来。

payload.name: SIXT
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SIXT enables users to search for and book rental cars directly from ChatGPT. The app helps users find available vehicles by location and date, compare car options, and review key rental details before booking. Once a suitable option is selected, users are directed to SIXT’s official website to complete their reservation. The app is designed to make the car rental booking process faster and more convenient by providing clear, relevant information at the moment users are planning their trips.

payload.name: Eurostar
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Travel effortlessly through Europe with the official Eurostar ChatGPT app. We provide real-time Eurostar schedules, fares and availability so you can find and book the best trains without leaving your chat. Our live data covers all Eurostar routes across France, Belgium, the Netherlands, Germany and the UK.

- Popular routes: Quickly check the schedules and fares for London to Paris, London to Brussels, London to Amsterdam & Rotterdam, and Paris to Brussels, Amsterdam, Rotterdam. These high-speed connections run frequently between city centres (e.g., London St Pancras to Paris Gare du Nord).
- Full Eurostar network: Plan trips to Cologne, Lille, Antwerp, Ghent, Düsseldorf, and Liège. Some journeys require a change; our app will clearly label these.
- Effortless booking: See live fares and then book in seconds. Tap Book on Eurostar on your chosen itinerary, and we’ll deep-link you to Eurostar.com with your trip pre-loaded in the basket for fast checkout.
payload.longDescription:
使用 Eurostar 官方 ChatGPT 应用，轻松畅游欧洲。我们提供实时 Eurostar 时刻表、票价和余票信息，让你无需离开聊天即可查找和预订最佳列车。实时数据覆盖 Eurostar 在法国、比利时、荷兰、德国和英国的所有线路。

- 热门路线：快速查询伦敦至巴黎、伦敦至布鲁塞尔、伦敦至阿姆斯特丹和鹿特丹，以及巴黎至布鲁塞尔、阿姆斯特丹和鹿特丹的时刻表与票价。这些高速线路频繁往返于市中心之间（例如伦敦圣潘克拉斯站至巴黎北站）。
- 完整 Eurostar 网络：规划前往科隆、里尔、安特卫普、根特、杜塞尔多夫和列日的行程。部分旅程需要换乘；应用会清楚标明。
- 轻松预订：查看实时票价，并在几秒内预订。点击所选行程上的“在 Eurostar 预订”，我们会通过深层链接跳转到 Eurostar.com，并预先将行程载入购物篮，方便快速结账。

payload.name: Viator
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Discover and book unforgettable things to do with the Viator app.
Search Viator's catalog of tours, attractions, and experiences using natural language. Just tell us where you're going and what you're interested in, and we will help you explore relevant options quickly and clearly.
You can narrow results by destination, dates, price range, and categories, making it easy to move from a broad idea ("things to do in Paris") to options that fit your plans and budget. Each result focuses on practical details, so you can compare experiences without jumping between pages or tabs.

payload.name: Bed-and-Breakfast.it
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Bed-and-Breakfast.it is an app designed to help travelers discover and book authentic Italian accommodations directly with the property owners, without commissions or intermediaries.

The app provides access to thousands of bed and breakfasts, vacation rentals, agriturismi and guesthouses across Italy, all managed by independent hosts. Availability and prices are provided directly by the accommodations, ensuring transparency, direct contact and fair conditions for both travelers and hosts.

Users can search by destination, dates and preferences, explore detailed property profiles, and interact with real hosts for tailored information. Where available, instant booking allows travelers to confirm their stay immediately, while maintaining a direct relationship with the accommodation.

With over twenty years of experience in the Italian hospitality market, Bed-and-Breakfast.it focuses on simplicity, trust and sustainability, offering a practical alternative to large commission-based booking platforms.
payload.longDescription:
Bed-and-Breakfast.it 帮助旅行者直接向业主寻找和预订地道的意大利住宿，无需佣金或中介。

应用提供意大利各地数千家住宿加早餐旅馆、度假租赁住所、农庄住宿和客栈，均由独立房东经营。房源直接提供可订情况和价格，确保信息透明、直接联系，并为旅行者与房东提供公平条件。

用户可以按目的地、日期和偏好搜索，查看详细房源资料，并与真实房东互动，获取个性化信息。在支持的情况下，即时预订让旅行者立即确认住宿，同时保持与住宿方的直接关系。

凭借在意大利住宿市场超过二十年的经验，Bed-and-Breakfast.it 注重简单、信任和可持续性，为大型佣金制预订平台提供切实可用的替代选择。

payload.name: Lambus
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Lambus is your new all-in-one travel planner, allowing you to manage every aspect of your trip: Itineraries, expenses, points of interest, daily plans and much more. Plan with ease inside ChatGPT and then hand over to the Lambus app during your trip to collaborate with your fellow travellers, access your trip offline and receive live alerts if your flight is delayed.
payload.longDescription: Lambus 是一款一体化旅行规划工具，可帮助你管理行程的方方面面：路线、开销、兴趣地点、每日计划等。在 ChatGPT 中轻松规划，然后在旅途中切换到 Lambus 应用，与同行者协作、离线查看行程，并在航班延误时接收实时提醒。

payload.name: DirectBooker
payload.description: 查找优质酒店并直接预订
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
DirectBooker — Book hotels direct for better rates and better service

DirectBooker helps you discover, compare, and book hotels at your destination for all your travel planning needs. Find accommodation in the right neighborhood, with the right vibe, and the amenities you need. See photos, real-time rates and availability for every property. Unlock member prices and special packages available only when you book directly. 

And when you book, you book straight with the hotel on their official website, so you get the direct rate and keep everything you've earned: points, elite status and benefits, and exclusive member offers. DirectBooker helps you find great rates for booking independent and boutique hotels, as well as  hotels from all major hotel brands worldwide, including as Best Western, Choice, Hilton, Hyatt, Marriott, Radisson, and more. 

From a last-minute airport room tonight to a resort or wellness retreat booked weeks ahead, DirectBooker helps you plan your trip and book smarter.

Direct is best. Better rates, better service, better travel.

Travel planning • hotel search • hotel booking • compare hotel rates • direct hotel deals • trip planning • accommodation • loyalty points & rewards • hotels • hotel • accommodations • booking • travel • travel booking • resort • hotel spa • trip planning
payload.longDescription:
DirectBooker——直接预订酒店，享受更优价格和更好服务

DirectBooker 可帮助你发现、比较并预订目的地酒店，满足各种旅行规划需求。找到位于合适街区、氛围符合期待且配备所需设施的住宿。查看每家酒店的照片、实时价格和空房情况。预订直订专享的会员价和特别套餐。

预订时，你会直接通过酒店官方网站完成，因此可享受直订价格，并保留已获得的一切：积分、精英会员身份及权益，以及专属会员优惠。DirectBooker 帮你以优惠价格预订独立酒店和精品酒店，也可预订全球各大酒店品牌的住宿，包括 Best Western、Choice、Hilton、Hyatt、Marriott、Radisson 等。

无论是今晚临时预订机场附近的房间，还是提前数周预订度假村或康养静修之旅，DirectBooker 都能帮你规划行程并更聪明地预订。

直订更好。价格更优，服务更佳，旅行更舒心。

payload.name: Kismet
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Kismet connects you directly to collections of professionally managed vacation rentals — every kind of stay professional managers run, from a hideaway for two to a compound that sleeps the whole reunion — with the depth your AI needs to actually plan a trip, not just search one. Start as vague as real plans start ("somewhere dog-friendly on the coast in October") and let your AI do the real work: compare multiple weekends in a single ask, including the price swings between them; see true totals with the manager's fees and estimated taxes counted — cleaning, pets, and the rest they disclose — before you fall in love with anything; and never hit a dead end — if your dates don't work, you get the nearest ones that do.

Every property carries full photo galleries, complete amenities, pet policies, house rules, and what past guests actually say, so weighing a pet-friendly cabin for two against a beach house for the whole family happens in one conversation instead of a dozen open tabs. Shortlist your finalists, then book direct on the manager's own site — your exact dates carried through, rates straight from the manager, no marketplace service fees added on top.
payload.longDescription:
Kismet 将你直接连接到专业管理的度假租赁房源集合——从适合两人的隐秘住所，到能容纳整个聚会的房屋，应有尽有，提供足够丰富的信息，让 AI 真正规划旅行，而不只是搜索。你可以从模糊的真实需求开始（例如“十月海边、允许带狗的地方”），让 AI 在一次请求中比较多个周末及价格波动；在心动之前查看包含管理方费用和预估税费的真实总价（包括清洁费、宠物费及管理方披露的其他费用）；如果原定日期不可行，还能获得最近的可行日期。

每套房源都有完整的照片库、设施、宠物政策、房屋规则和过往住客的真实评价，因此你可以在一次对话中权衡适合两人的宠物友好小屋与适合全家入住的海滨别墅，无需打开十几个标签页。选出候选房源后，可在管理方自己的网站上直接预订——准确日期会传递过去，价格直接来自管理方，不会额外加收平台服务费。

payload.name: TravExp
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
TravExp slashes the time to plan a trip that matches your taste by up to 90%, so you can spend more time enjoying the experience and less time stressing over details.

This app elevates your travel planning experience on ChatGPT by directly integrating into the conversation flow.  You can instantly turn ChatGPT-generated itineraries into rich, visual trip plans that are editable and collaborative. You can even create a brand-new personalized itinerary right from the chat. TravExp creates beautiful, visual itineraries packed with essential details, including places to visit, reviews, seasonal insights, must-do activities, and more.

You can also easily setup a planning workspace by directly opening the itinerary on TravExp where you can leverage supporting features like navigation, local tips, exclusive deals, packing essentials, and AI-powered travel assistance.

payload.name: Flygresor.se

payload.name: Swarm by Foursquare
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Swarm helps you discover places, check in to where you go, and keep a personal history of your favorite spots. Find restaurants, cafés, parks, museums, bars, and other places nearby or anywhere in the world. Get recommendations based on location, save places to visit later, create and manage lists, and see where you've been over time.

Whether you're planning a trip, exploring a new neighborhood, or trying to remember the great coffee shop you visited last year, Swarm makes it easy to find, organize, and revisit the places that matter to you.

payload.name: Turo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Search Turo's inventory on ChatGPT to find any car you want, wherever you want it, from a vibrant community of trusted hosts.

Whether you need an SUV for Tahoe or a convertible for the coast, just describe your plans and get tailored recommendations in seconds to ensure you find the perfect vehicle for your trip.

payload.name: BreckenWander Travel

BreckenWander shows the all-in total — every mandatory tax and fee included — for flights, hotels, and experiences, and assembles them into one multi-part itinerary. Booking finishes in a single checkout on breckenwander.com, where BreckenWander is the merchant of record. Read-only in chat; no account needed.
payload.longDescription: 在一个地方规划并估算完整行程。BreckenWander 展示航班、酒店和体验的全包总价——包含所有必缴税费——并将它们组合成多段行程。在 breckenwander.com 上通过一次结账完成预订，BreckenWander 是登记商家。聊天中只读；无需账户。

payload.name: DiscoverCars.com
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find the right car rental anywhere in the world, fast and without hassle.

The DiscoverCars.com app helps you compare car rental offers from hundreds of trusted suppliers in one place. You can quickly see prices, car types, insurance options and rental conditions, so you can book with confidence and avoid surprises at pickup.

What you can do
- Compare car rental prices across local and global providers  
- See clear rental terms before you book  
- Choose the right insurance and fuel policy for your trip  
- Find cars at airports and city locations worldwide  
- Book in minutes with instant confirmation

payload.longDescription:
快速、轻松地在世界各地找到合适的租车服务。

你可以做什么

- 在全球机场和市区地点查找车辆

为什么选择 DiscoverCars.com？

- 深受客户信赖——Trustpilot 评分 4.6，基于超过 250,000 条评价
- 获得行业认可——六次荣获 World Travel Awards
- 全球覆盖——在全球 10,000 个地点与 1000 多家供应商合作

用户喜欢它的原因
- 在一个视图中展示优质选项，节省时间

- 由专注租车服务的团队提供支持

无论你计划周末短途旅行还是长假，DiscoverCars.com 都能让租车变得简单省心。

payload.name: Motel One
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find Motel One and The Cloud One hotels worldwide directly from ChatGPT. Search by city, neighborhood, landmark, dates, budget, or travel context. The app returns availability and pricing, location details, amenities, ratings, an interactive map, and direct booking links to official Motel One systems. It supports English and German hotel-search prompts and does not complete reservations or take payments within ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: 直接在 ChatGPT 中查找全球的 Motel One 和 The Cloud One 酒店。可按城市、街区、地标、日期、预算或旅行场景搜索。应用会返回可用性和价格、位置详情、设施、评分、互动地图以及官方 Motel One 系统的直接预订链接。支持英语和德语酒店搜索提示，不在 ChatGPT 内完成预订或收款。

payload.name: Almosafer.com
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Finding your perfect journey has never been easier with the Almosafer ChatGPT app. Explore tailored flight and stay options with real-time prices, high-quality photos, and detailed ratings all in one place. Spotted something you love? Effortlessly finalise your booking with instant confirmation on Almosafer. 

Elevate your travel planning with the Almosafer ChatGPT app. Simply ask Almosafer to find the best flights and hotels from over 450 airlines and 1.5 million hotels, compare real guest reviews, and browse live pricing all in one chat. Whether you need a flexible flight or a hotel with free cancellation, you can go from "searching" to "booked" with instant confirmation on Almosafer and the security of 24/7 customer support. 

Add the Almosafer app to ChatGPT and book your next trip today.
payload.longDescription:
使用Almosafer ChatGPT应用，找到完美旅程从未如此轻松。在同一处探索为你定制的航班与住宿选项，查看实时价格、高质量照片和详细评分。发现喜欢的选项？在Almosafer上轻松完成预订，即时获得确认。

使用Almosafer ChatGPT应用提升旅行规划体验。只需让Almosafer从超过450家航空公司和1.5百万家酒店中寻找最佳航班与酒店、比较真实住客评价，并在同一个聊天中浏览实时价格。无论你需要可灵活调整的航班，还是提供免费取消的酒店，都能在Almosafer上从“搜索”进入“已预订”状态，获得即时确认，并享有24/7客户支持带来的保障。

立即将Almosafer应用添加到ChatGPT，预订下一次旅行。

payload.name: Zio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The app lets ChatGPT retrieve read-only fleet information such as live vehicle status, locations, trip summaries, travel distance, stoppages, idling, inactive vehicles, overspeed events, AC and digital-port sensor usage, temperature reports, fuel fill/drain summaries, route playback, system logs, and product help documentation. Several tools can render ChatGPT Apps SDK widgets, including fleet maps, playback maps, report dashboards, and documentation cards.

payload.name: TBT
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Book ferry tickets, longtail boats, speedboats, snorkeling trips, and island tours across Thailand — directly in ChatGPT and social chat channels like WhatsApp, Instagram DM, Telegram, and Facebook Messenger. No forms, no redirects to a website. Just tell the app where you want to go and when, confirm the option you like, and get your ticket by email.
Covers 50+ destinations and 40+ local boat operators, including Koh Samui, Koh Phangan, Koh Tao, Bangkok, Phi Phi, Phuket, Krabi, Koh Lanta, and Koh Lipe — plus access to every island in Thailand. Compares routes by speed, price, and comfort, and handles multi-leg journeys that combine bus and ferry, or several ferries in a row, as a single booking.
Often cheaper than booking each leg separately, with a faster, simpler flow than traditional booking sites. Every booking is double-checked by a human team based in Thailand, so connection times actually work. Real support is available any time at no extra cost — through ChatGPT, WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, or Telegram.
Pay in any major currency with cards, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Klarna, Alipay, WeChat Pay, and more. Officially licensed and registered in Thailand.

payload.name: Get My eSIM
payload.description: 比较旅行 eSIM 套餐
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find and compare travel eSIM plans across 200+ destinations from 30+ providers. Search by country or region to see plans with pricing, data allowances, validity, and ratings. Filter by your data needs and view prices in 60+ currencies. Each plan includes coverage details, speeds, restrictions, and direct purchase links. Compare hundreds of eSIM plans in one place, instead of checking multiple websites.
payload.longDescription: 比较来自 30 多家服务商、覆盖 200 多个目的地的旅行 eSIM 套餐。按国家或地区搜索，查看套餐价格、流量额度、有效期和评分。按流量需求筛选，并以 60 多种货币查看价格。每个套餐均包含覆盖范围、网速、限制和直接购买链接。无需逐一查看多个网站，即可在一处比较数百种 eSIM 套餐。

payload.name: Wyndham Hotels & Resorts
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
With Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, you can plan your trip, discover new destinations, and compare hotels using natural conversation—all within ChatGPT. Whether you're planning a family vacation, business stay, or road trip, you can explore your options before seamlessly continuing to Wyndham Hotels & Resorts to book directly.

Explore thousands of hotels in more than 95 countries across trusted brands for every travel preference and budget, including economy brands like Super 8®, Days Inn®, Microtel®, and Travelodge®; midscale brands like La Quinta®, Baymont®, Ramada®, and Wingate®; and upscale brands like Wyndham®, Wyndham Grand®, Dolce®, and Registry Collection Hotels®.

Find hotels the way you naturally talk and get personalized recommendations tailored to your needs. Simply search by destination, budget, travel dates, local attractions, and more. You’ll be able to compare hotel amenities and prices across Wyndham Hotels & Resorts' portfolio—from affordable hotels and airport stays to beach resorts, extended-stay options, pet-friendly rooms, and business accommodations.

You can also explore how to use and maximize your Wyndham Rewards® points for free and discounted nights around the world.

Try asking:

* Find a pet-friendly hotel near Great Smoky Mountains National Park under $175 per night.
* Compare family-friendly hotels in Orlando with free breakfast and a pool.
* Recommend a beach vacation in Mexico under $250 per night.
* Show me airport hotels near LAX for an early morning flight.
* Which Wyndham hotel near a beach in Europe gives me the best value for 100,000 Wyndham Rewards points?
* Plan a New England road trip with Wyndham hotels along the route.
payload.longDescription:
通过 Wyndham Hotels & Resorts，你可以完全在 ChatGPT 中用自然对话规划旅行、发现新目的地并比较酒店。无论是计划家庭度假、商务住宿还是公路旅行，都可以先了解选项，再无缝前往 Wyndham Hotels & Resorts 直接预订。

在 95 多个国家/地区探索数千家酒店，涵盖适合各种旅行偏好和预算的可信品牌，包括经济型品牌 Super 8®、Days Inn®、Microtel® 和 Travelodge®；中档品牌 La Quinta®、Baymont®、Ramada® 和 Wingate®；以及高档品牌 Wyndham®、Wyndham Grand®、Dolce® 和 Registry Collection Hotels®。

像平常聊天一样查找酒店，并获取根据需求定制的个性化推荐。只需按目的地、预算、出行日期、当地景点等条件搜索。你可以比较 Wyndham Hotels & Resorts 旗下酒店的设施和价格——从实惠酒店和机场住宿，到海滨度假村、长住选项、宠物友好客房及商务住宿。

你还可以了解如何使用并最大化利用 Wyndham Rewards® 积分，在世界各地兑换免费或优惠住宿。

可以尝试这样提问：

* 查找大烟山国家公园附近每晚低于 $175 的宠物友好酒店。
* 比较奥兰多提供免费早餐和泳池的家庭友好型酒店。
* 推荐墨西哥每晚低于 $250 的海滨度假行程。
* 为搭乘清晨航班的旅客查找 LAX 附近的机场酒店。
* 欧洲海滩附近哪家 Wyndham 酒店使用 100,000 Wyndham Rewards 积分最划算？
* 规划一趟新英格兰公路旅行，沿途安排 Wyndham 酒店。

payload.name: Hertz Car Rental

Compare options, choose available extras, and finish your booking securely on Hertz.com.
payload.longDescription:
在 ChatGPT 中查找并预订 Hertz 租车。提供取车地点、出行日期和车辆需求，Hertz 应用便会显示符合行程的可用车辆。

比较选项、选择可用附加服务，并在 Hertz.com 上安全完成预订。

payload.name: tiket.com
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
tiket.com is a pioneer online travel agent (OTA) in Indonesia, established in 2011. It is one of the largest and most comprehensive online travel companies in the country, offering flight tickets, train tickets, accommodations, villas & apartments, event tickets, car rentals, and other travel-related services. Our mission is to provide the best online travel booking access through both web and mobile applications.

In 2017, tiket.com became affiliated with Blibli, and in 2021 officially became a consolidated subsidiary of Blibli. Blibli operates a unified omnichannel ecosystem known as Blibli Tiket, which comprises its subsidiaries tiket.com, Ranch Market and Dekoruma. This ecosystem synergy enhances customer convenience and delivers added value by providing more comprehensive, beneficial, and integrated services across every channel and platform. In 2022, Blibli was officially listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX) under the stock code “BELI.”
payload.longDescription:
tiket.com 是印度尼西亚的先驱在线旅行社（OTA），成立于 2011 年。它是该国规模最大、服务最全面的在线旅游公司之一，提供机票、火车票、住宿、别墅和公寓、活动门票、汽车租赁及其他旅行相关服务。我们的使命是通过网站和移动应用，提供最佳的在线旅行预订服务。

2017 年，tiket.com 与 Blibli 建立关联，2021 年正式成为 Blibli 的合并子公司。Blibli 运营名为 Blibli Tiket 的统一全渠道生态系统，其中包括其子公司 tiket.com、Ranch Market 和 Dekoruma。该生态系统的协同效应提升客户便利性，并通过在各渠道和平台提供更全面、更有益且一体化的服务创造额外价值。2022 年，Blibli 在印度尼西亚证券交易所（IDX）正式上市，股票代码为“BELI”。

payload.name: TRAIL Hike Planner & Camping
payload.description: Get a full road trip itinerary
payload.summaryOriginal: Get a full road trip itinerary
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: 101 TRAIL! plans your entire hiking and camping trip from start to finish. Get a complete day-by-day itinerary with trails, campgrounds, campsites, driving routes, and nearby towns, matched to your fitness level, difficulty, and the scenery you want. 101 TRAIL! covers the full plan: maps, trailheads, permits, gear checklists, food and water stops, best seasons, and backup options for weather. From easy day hikes to multi-day backpacking treks and national park adventures. Just describe your trip and get a ready-to-go outdoor plan — not just the trail, but the whole journey around it: how to get there, where to sleep, what to pack, and what to do if the weather turns.

payload.name: JourneyBay
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: JourneyBay helps travelers plan and manage trips from ChatGPT. Users can view upcoming trips, inspect day-by-day itineraries, search places, manage saved places, create and update trips, import itineraries planned in conversation, generate or adjust itineraries, retrieve visa information, and chat with the JourneyBay travel assistant.
payload.longDescription: JourneyBay 帮助旅行者通过 ChatGPT 规划和管理行程。用户可以查看即将开始的旅行、检查逐日行程、搜索地点、管理已保存地点、创建和更新旅行、导入对话中规划的行程、生成或调整行程、获取签证信息，并与 JourneyBay 旅行助手聊天。

payload.name: AirHelp
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Was your flight delayed, cancelled, or were you denied boarding? 

AirHelp tells you in seconds when you're owed compensation — and how much. Just fill in your flight details and we’ll estimate your payout. Connecting journeys with missed connections are covered too. 

When you're eligible, you can start your claim right away.

AirHelp has checked over 25 million claims under EU, UK, Turkish and Brazilian laws. We can get you the compensation you’re owed, but we can’t assist with flight refunds, baggage or travel insurance claims. 
eal-time flight status, hotel or car rental bookings, or general trip planning.
payload.longDescription:
你的航班是否延误、取消，或你被拒绝登机？

AirHelp会在几秒内告诉你何时有权获得赔偿，以及能获得多少。只需填写航班信息，我们就会估算赔付金额。因错过转机而受影响的联程也在覆盖范围内。

符合条件后，你可以立即开始索赔。

AirHelp已根据欧盟、英国、土耳其和巴西法律核查超过25百万宗索赔。我们可以帮助你获得应得的赔偿，但不能协助处理机票退款、行李或旅行保险索赔。
也不提供实时航班状态、酒店或租车预订，或一般旅行规划。

payload.name: Trabber
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Trabber is a travel metasearch engine. Search for a flight, a place to stay or a rental car, and you get the current prices from the airline, travel agency, hotel and car rental websites that sell it, side by side, plus a direct link to book the one you pick on that seller's own website.

Why that helps: the identical trip can cost quite different amounts depending on where you buy it, and the cheapest seller changes from one route or property to the next. Checking by hand means a dozen browser tabs. Here you ask once.

What you can search:

- Flights, one way, return or multi-city.

- Accommodation of any kind: hotels, apartments, aparthotels, hostels, guest houses, villas, campgrounds.

- Rental cars.

- Flight deals, for when you have no destination or dates in mind yet.

Narrow any search down by asking: direct flights only, morning departures, breakfast and free cancellation, automatic with unlimited mileage. Connect your Trabber account and you can pick your recent searches back up.

Trabber doesn't sell travel. You book, pay and get support on the seller's website, under their terms.

payload.name: Rail Monsters - Train Tickets
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Access train tickets for thousands of routes across the globe. Rail Monsters provides an all in one booking experience, official train tickets and transparent pricing with instant delivery. Whether you’re commuting or exploring a new continent, get the best routes backed by 24/7 human support to ensure your journey stays on track. Simple, secure, and global.

payload.name: Meow Map
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Meow Map searches a curated database of hotels, ryokans, guesthouses, and cat cafés where guests have actually seen a resident cat on the property. Every result is sourced from verified guest reviews mentioning real cats.

Search by city name or GPS coordinates. Results include the cat's name (when known), a summary of what guests said about it, and how recent the data is.

Useful for planning cat-themed travel itineraries, finding pet-adjacent accommodation, or just wanting to stay somewhere with a hotel cat.

All results can be explored on the full interactive map at meowmap.dev
payload.longDescription:
Meow Map 会搜索经过整理的数据库，其中收录了酒店、日式旅馆、宾馆和猫咖；住客曾在这些场所实际见过常驻猫咪。每条结果都来自经核实且提及真实猫咪的住客评论。

按城市名称或 GPS 坐标搜索。结果包含猫咪的名字（如已知）、住客对它的评价摘要，以及数据的更新时间。

适合规划猫主题旅行行程、寻找与宠物有关的住宿，或只是想住在有酒店猫的地方。

所有结果都可以在 meowmap.dev 的完整互动地图上查看。

payload.name: Hotels Booking
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Hotels Booking helps users discover configured hotels, create private booking sessions, search rooms and extras, manage a booking basket, review quotes, and submit guest contact details to complete hotel reservations through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Hotels Booking 帮助用户查找已配置的酒店、创建私人预订会话、搜索客房和附加服务、管理预订购物篮、查看报价，并通过 ChatGPT 提交宾客联系信息以完成酒店预订。

payload.name: TrainPal
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search train routes across the UK and other European countries in ChatGPT. View journey options with departure and arrival times, duration, transfers, and pricing when available, then continue on TrainPal for more details and next steps.

payload.name: Adin Flights
payload.description: 在聊天中查找和预订航班
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Adin Flights by MoodTrip.Ai lets you search, compare and book real flights directly inside ChatGPT using natural language. Powered by LiteAPI's global flight inventory, Adin Flights resolves cities to IATA codes, streams live fares from hundreds of carriers, verifies offers in real time, and hands off to a secure deep-link checkout on flights.moodtrip.ai  Guests can book without an account; signed-in users get booking history, PNR retrieval, and cancellation support — all from chat.
payload.longDescription: MoodTrip.Ai 的 Adin Flights 让你使用自然语言直接在 ChatGPT 内搜索、比较和预订真实航班。借助 LiteAPI 的全球航班库存，Adin Flights 将城市解析为 IATA 代码，持续提供数百家航空公司的实时票价，实时核验报价，并跳转至 flights.moodtrip.ai 上安全的深层链接结账页面。游客无需账户即可预订；登录用户可获取预订历史、检索 PNR，并获得取消支持，全部可在聊天中完成。

payload.name: Abandoned World App
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Discover abandoned places near you, explore them on an interactive map, and jump into full place pages with photos and details. Abandoned World App makes it easy to find urbex spots by city, ZIP code, or location and start exploring faster.
payload.longDescription: 发现附近的废弃地点，在交互式地图上探索，并进入附照片和详情的完整地点页面。Abandoned World App 让你轻松按城市、邮政编码或位置查找城市探索地点，更快开始探索。

payload.name: ADAC Mietwagen
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
ADAC Autovermietung – Günstig weltweit vergleichen & buchen

Mit dem ADAC Mietwagen Preisvergleich finden Mitglieder weltweit günstige Mietwagen und vergleichen Angebote seriöser, zuverlässiger Autovermieter. Profitieren Sie von exklusiven ADAC Mitgliedervorteilen, besten Konditionen und transparenten Mietpreisen ohne versteckte Zusatzkosten.

Große Auswahl an Fahrzeugklassen – vom Kleinwagen über SUV und Van bis Premium. Flexible Abholung am Flughafen, in der Stadt oder mit Koordinaten.

Jetzt Mietwagen buchen und ADAC Mitgliedervorteile sichern.
payload.longDescription:
ADAC 汽车租赁——比较并预订全球优惠租车

通过 ADAC Mietwagen 租车比价，会员可以在全球找到优惠租车，并比较信誉良好、可靠的租车公司的报价。享受 ADAC 会员专属权益、优惠条件和透明租价，没有隐藏的额外费用。

丰富的车型选择——从小型车、SUV 和厢式车到高端车型。灵活选择在机场、市区或指定坐标取车。

立即预订租车，享受 ADAC 会员权益。

payload.name: FareFirst
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
FareFirst helps you find the cheapest one-way flights in seconds. Our powerful real-time flight search engine scans 1000+ trusted travel websites instantly to bring you the lowest available fares worldwide. Whether you're booking in advance or searching for last-minute deals, FareFirst ensures you always get the best one-way ticket options at the best price.

We search and compare thousands of verified online travel agencies and airline websites with a single click. Our optimized meta-search technology aggregates fares directly from airlines and trusted OTAs, giving you transparent pricing with no hidden fees. FareFirst covers both domestic and international routes, helping travelers discover the hottest airfare deals globally.
payload.longDescription:
FareFirst 帮助你在几秒内找到最便宜的单程航班。强大的实时航班搜索引擎会即时扫描 1000+个可信旅行网站，为你带来全球最低可用票价。无论提前预订还是临时寻找优惠，FareFirst 都能帮你以优惠价格找到最佳单程机票。

只需点击一次，我们就会搜索并比较数千家经过验证的在线旅行社和航空公司网站。优化后的元搜索技术直接汇总航空公司和可信 OTA 的票价，价格透明，没有隐藏费用。FareFirst 覆盖国内和国际航线，帮助旅客发现全球热门机票优惠。

payload.name: EconomyBookings
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
EconomyBookings helps travelers easily search and compare rental cars worldwide. Find available vehicles by pickup location, travel dates, driver age, and preferences like car category, transmission type, supplier, model, and total rental price, all through natural conversation.

What you can do:

- Search for rental cars by city, airport, or pickup location
- Filter results by vehicle type, transmission, supplier, price range, fuel policy, and more
- Compare car hire options with pricing, supplier ratings, included features, and rental conditions
- Browse vehicle details including luggage capacity, passenger limits, and transmission type
- Get direct booking links to continue your reservation with EconomyBookings.

Results include trusted rental suppliers, transparent pricing, and key rental terms to help you compare options confidently before booking.
payload.longDescription:
EconomyBookings 可帮助旅行者轻松搜索和比较全球租车服务。通过自然对话，按取车地点、旅行日期、驾驶员年龄以及车型类别、变速箱类型、供应商、车型和租车总价等偏好查找可租车辆。

你可以：

- 按城市、机场或取车地点搜索租车
- 按车辆类型、变速箱、供应商、价格范围、燃油政策等筛选结果
- 比较租车选项的价格、供应商评分、包含的功能和租赁条件
- 浏览车辆详情，包括行李容量、乘客人数限制和变速箱类型
- 获取直接预订链接，继续在 EconomyBookings 上完成预订。

结果包含可信的租车供应商、透明价格和关键租赁条款，帮助你在预订前放心比较选项。

payload.name: Cleartrip
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Looking for a flight? Just tell us where and when! Search, compare, and find the right option through a seamless booking experience. Browse fares across airlines, filter by nonstop routes or lowest fares, and check cancellation charges and baggage allowance – all in a single conversation. Once you select a route, we’ll take you to the Cleartrip app to complete the booking. 
The joy of planning a trip starts on Cleartrip.
payload.longDescription:
想找航班？告诉我们目的地和日期即可！通过流畅的预订体验进行搜索和比较，找到合适的选择。在多个航空公司的票价中浏览，按直飞航线或最低票价筛选，并在一次对话中查看取消费用和行李额度。选定航线后，我们会带你前往 Cleartrip 应用完成预订。
旅行规划的乐趣，从 Cleartrip 开始。

We empower 40 million+ customers to instantly compare and book the best fares for airport transfers, private taxis, ride-hailing, and shared shuttles in one place.

With real-time access to a network of 70,000+ vetted local providers, @hoppa ensures reliable fixed-price travel tailored to every journey and budget. Trusted by the world’s leading payment networks, including Mastercard, Visa, UnionPay, and Alipay, we simplify last-mile travel for every traveller.

payload.name: Yango
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Get an instant, upfront fare estimate and full trip details before you book.

What you can do:
• See the exact price for your route with no hidden fees
• Compare travel time for different routing options
• Check estimated time of arrival (ETA) and car arrival time
• Find the best pickup points to save time and money
• Go straight to booking – your estimate opens seamlessly in the Yango app to complete your ride securely

Yango uses live traffic data and smart routing to provide accurate, real‑time trip planning.
payload.longDescription:
预订前即可获得即时、预先报价和完整行程详情。

你可以：
• 查看路线的确切价格，无隐藏费用
• 比较不同路线方案的出行时间
• 查看预计到达时间（ETA）和车辆到达时间
• 查找能节省时间和金钱的最佳上车地点
• 直接开始预订——报价会无缝打开 Yango 应用，让你安全完成行程预订

Yango 使用实时交通数据和智能路线规划，提供准确的实时行程规划。

payload.name: Civitatis
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Civitatis helps users discover tours and activities by destination, inspect activity details, check available dates and sessions, build an itinerary, add selected sessions to a cart, and continue checkout on Civitatis.
payload.longDescription: Civitatis 帮助用户按目的地发现旅游和活动、查看活动详情、查询可选日期和场次、制定行程、将选定场次加入购物车，并继续在 Civitatis 完成结账。

payload.name: Travelenie
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Travelenie is your personal Al travel assistant, designed to handle the complex details of every trip so you can focus on enjoying the journey. From the moment you start planning to your final photo caption, Travelenie organizes your entire trip lifecycle.

payload.name: Recreation.gov
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search and explore campgrounds across Recreation.gov. Find campgrounds by location or keyword, check campsite availability for specific dates, view detailed campground and campsite information including photos, amenities, and pricing. Filter results by camping type, vehicle length, electricity, amenities, and more. Includes an interactive map and rich visual cards for browsing results.

payload.name: eSIM Copilot
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: eSIM Copilot helps users find mobile plans for home and abroad.  Use ChatGPT to help you create an account, buy and install eSIMs that save you money, manage plans, troubleshoot your network connect and analyse your account activity.
payload.longDescription: eSIM Copilot 帮助查找国内外移动套餐，创建账户、购买和安装 eSIM、管理套餐、排查网络连接并分析账户活动。

payload.name: Cruisebound
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Cruisebound makes it easy to search, compare, and book cruises online. 

Cruisebound is an accredited travel agency that works directly with all major cruise lines. We search and compare all promotions and automatically filter onto the lowest prices. We also offer unique features like short term Hold for Free, No Deposit bookings, loyalty benefits as part of the Cruisebound Rewards program, and no booking fees. 

We are backed by top-rated customer service.
payload.longDescription:
Cruisebound 让在线搜索、比较和预订邮轮变得简单。

Cruisebound 是一家获认证的旅行社，与所有主要邮轮公司直接合作。我们搜索并比较所有促销活动，并自动筛选出最低价格。我们还提供短期免费保留舱位、无需定金即可预订、Cruisebound Rewards 忠诚会员福利以及免预订费等独特功能。

我们拥有顶级客户服务团队的支持。

payload.name: Cottages
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
There's a cottage with your name on it in our ChatGPT app! 

Tell us what you're looking for in your own words and let us show you what's available from over 18,000 quality-checked cottages across the UK. Need more information or want to check other options? Ask away! With clear pricing, verified reviews, and stress free booking. we'll help find the right cottage for you across coast and countryside, from romantic hideaways to big family stays. Discover real availability, compare favourites, and book with confidence, all in one easy place.
payload.longDescription:
我们的 ChatGPT 应用里有一间专属于你的度假小屋！

用自己的话告诉我们你在寻找什么，我们会展示英国各地超过 18,000 间经过质量审核的小屋。需要更多信息或想查看其他选择？尽管询问！我们提供清晰的价格、经核实的评价和轻松无忧的预订体验，帮你在海滨和乡间找到合适的小屋，从浪漫隐居地到适合大家庭入住的房源。你可以在一个简单易用的地方查看真实空房情况、比较心仪选项并放心预订。

payload.name: Paytm Travel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search and compare live Paytm flight and intercity bus options in ChatGPT. Explore fares, schedules, and filters; review flight price breakdowns and fare rules; inspect bus amenities, boarding and dropping points, and cancellation policies; then continue on Paytm to complete your booking.
payload.longDescription: 在 ChatGPT 中搜索和比较 Paytm 实时航班及城际巴士选项。浏览票价、时刻表和筛选条件；查看航班价格明细和票价规则；检查巴士设施、上下车地点及取消政策；随后前往 Paytm 完成预订。

payload.name: GoVola
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: GoVola helps you find flight offers without the usual hassle. Search and compare routes and prices across airlines, and discover smarter alternatives (including multi-airline combos) so you can pick the best fit for your time and budget.
payload.longDescription: GoVola 帮你轻松查找航班优惠。搜索并比较不同航空公司的航线和价格，发现更聪明的替代方案（包括多家航空公司的组合），以便选择最符合时间安排和预算的方案。

payload.name: Israir
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search Israir flights, vacation packages, available travel dates, and official passenger service links. Compare options for supported destinations, view prices and booking options, and find information about baggage, check-in, cancellations, accessibility, emergency updates, and Eilat flight programs.
payload.longDescription: 搜索 Israir 航班、度假套餐、可选出行日期和官方乘客服务链接。比较支持目的地的方案，查看价格和预订选项，并查找行李、值机、取消、无障碍服务、紧急通知和埃拉特航班计划相关信息。

payload.name: 12Go
payload.description: 查找巴士、渡轮等交通方式
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Travel the World with 12Go

The 12Go ChatGPT app helps you find and compare travel options in seconds. Just type what you need, and we’ll handle the rest. We cover buses, ferries, flights, trains and more to solve all your travel needs. 

No more jumping between tabs, filters, or travel sites. Just ask something like: “What’s the cheapest way to get from A to B for 3 people this Friday?” We’ll instantly surface the best matches and let you sort by price, departure time, currency, or recommended picks, including routes that combine multiple modes of transport.
payload.longDescription:
与 12Go 一起环游世界

12Go ChatGPT 应用帮助你在几秒内查找并比较出行选项。只需输入需求，其余交给我们。我们涵盖巴士、渡轮、航班、火车等交通方式，满足你的各种旅行需求。

无需在标签页、筛选器或旅行网站间来回切换。只需问：“这个星期五，3 个人从 A 到 B 最便宜的方式是什么？”我们会立即提供最匹配的选项，让你按价格、出发时间、币种或推荐选项排序，包括结合多种交通方式的路线。

payload.name: KKday
payload.description: 像当地人一样规划旅行
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
KKday helps travelers discover bookable travel experiences and services around the world.

Users can search for tours, attraction tickets, WiFi or eSIM connectivity, SIM cards, portable WiFi, and food experiences by describing their destination and what they are looking for.

The app returns relevant KKday products with useful details such as prices, ratings, photos, and product information in an easy-to-browse product carousel.

When users are ready, they can open the full KKday listing to learn more and complete their booking on KKday.

KKday makes it easier to compare travel options and find experiences that match each trip.
payload.longDescription:
KKday 帮助旅行者发现并预订全球各地可预订的旅行体验和服务。

用户可以描述目的地和需求，搜索旅行团、景点门票、WiFi 或 eSIM 连接、SIM 卡、便携 WiFi 和美食体验。

应用会通过易浏览的产品轮播展示相关 KKday 商品及实用详情，例如价格、评分、照片和商品信息。

准备好后，用户可以打开完整 KKday 商品页面了解详情，并在 KKday 上完成预订。

KKday 让比较旅行选择、寻找适合每趟行程的体验变得更轻松。

payload.name: Executive Hotels AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Executive Hotels AI helps guests explore hotels, compare room types, discover amenities, and plan seamless stays across Executive Hotels & Resorts properties in Canada and the United States. From luxury suites and rooftop dining to local recommendations and direct booking assistance, the app delivers fast, personalized hospitality support powered by AI.
payload.longDescription: Executive Hotels AI 帮助宾客探索酒店、比较房型、了解设施，并规划在加拿大和美国 Executive Hotels & Resorts 酒店的顺畅住宿体验。从豪华套房和屋顶餐饮，到本地推荐和直接预订协助，这款应用通过 AI 提供快速、个性化的酒店服务。

payload.name: eSIM Finder
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: eSIM Finder helps travellers find and compare prepaid travel eSIM data plans for 190+ countries and regions — without leaving the chat. Tell it your destination and trip length and it searches live plans, compares data allowances and prices in 40 currencies, explains the plan types, and gives you a link to the plan you choose. It also offers an Annual Travel Pass — one reusable data-only eSIM covering ~130 countries for 12 months. The connector is read-only and anonymous: no account, no sign-up, and it never sees your name, email, or conversation history. Purchases are completed on the provider's secure store; eSIM Finder takes no payments.
payload.longDescription: eSIM Finder 比较覆盖 190 多个国家和地区的旅行 eSIM 数据套餐，显示流量、40 种货币价格和套餐类型，并提供购买链接；另有覆盖约 130 国、12 个月可复用的年度通行证。连接器匿名只读，无需账户，不接触姓名、邮箱或历史；付款在供应商商店完成。

payload.name: FareHarbor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: FareHarbor helps people easily discover and book tours and activities around the world. Our app connects travelers with trusted local operators, making it simple to explore experiences like sightseeing tours, outdoor adventures, cultural activities, and attractions in one place. With up-to-date availability, clear options, and a seamless booking experience, FareHarbor takes the friction out of planning memorable experiences, whether you’re traveling or booking locally.
payload.longDescription: FareHarbor 帮助用户轻松发现并预订全球各地的旅游和活动。我们的应用将旅客与可信的本地运营商连接起来，让你可以在一个地方轻松探索观光游、户外探险、文化活动和景点。凭借最新的可订情况、清晰的选项和流畅的预订体验，无论旅行途中还是在本地预订，FareHarbor 都能让难忘体验的规划更简单。

payload.name: Book Direct
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Book-Direct.co helps travelers find hotels and vacation rentals that accept direct bookings
No middlemen, no hidden fees.

Search by location or property name to get:
• Property cards with photos, ratings, and reviews
• Official website links for direct contact
• Phone and email details for property owners
• Messaging options for instant communication

We identify your travel details (guests, dates, location) and generate ready-to-send messages.

The workflow is streamlined so you can contact property owners directly with a conversational message no extra steps needed.

payload.name: Is It Safe To Travel?
